points.point: Why line breaks vanish, post shows as one block
points.sentence: Long text with linebreaks needs escaping.

points.point: Escape Multi-Line Paragraphs error in n8n
Keep line breaks in a multi-paragraph post (LinkedIn)
points.sentence: To preserve newlines in posts with multiple paragraphs, use the function toJsonString() in n8n like this: "text": $("Prepare for Publish").item.json.final_text_long.toJsonString()

verdict.reason: The entry covers the n8n line-break and escape problem with sentences that apply to any multi-paragraph post, including LinkedIn, and it gives the toJsonString() fix for the Escape Multi-Line Paragraphs error.
